entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return a pair of cycling shoes. Order number 788-B45.
Okay, I can help with that. Let me just pull up that order. One moment... Got it. Can I ask what specifically is the issue with the shoes?
They don't fit right. I've tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but they're giving me terrible blisters after every ride. I just want a refund.
I'm sorry to hear that. Comfort is key. Let me just check the purchase date... I see you received them 51 days ago. That's perfectly fine. Our cycling shoes are covered by our 90-day return policy.
Good. So you'll process the return?

Yes, absolutely. I am emailing you a prepaid return label right now. Just pack them up, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, we will process your full refund. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
